duration.value: instantaneous DESCRIPTION This spell concentrates time, releasing it in a single burst in the round the caster finishes casting the spell. Following the completion of this spell, the caster receives his normal action for that round (plus any additional actions the character may be receiving from haste spells etc.) In addition, the caster receives 1d10 bonus standard actions that he may use either before, or after, his normal actions that round.
